description: Places parking vélos is a dataset listed in Saemes OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Saemes. Ce jeu de données fait état du nombre de places vélos dans les parkings Saemes. Coverage: Paris region (Saemes car parks). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are Parking public, Parking résidentiel, Parking vélo, Stationnement, Se garer, Paris. The portal shows 62 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-saemes-fr-portal.
